name: nvs_encryption_hmac
description: nvs_encryption_hmac, unmodified, on a new chip: no eFuse key block has the HMAC_UP purpose, so the NVS security provider generates a key, burns it into a key block with that purpose, read-protected, and derives the NVS XTS keys from it with the HMAC peripheral (the key never readable by software); the default and a custom NVS partition are then encrypted under them, and the custom one's values written and read back.

expect.contains: nvs_sec_provider: NVS Encryption - Registering HMAC-based scheme...
example: Key: str_key | Val: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet
